Paragraph: "We will search every forest, cross every ocean, and tear down every stronghold to rescue Seetha!"
Situation/Problem_Faced: Formulating a clear, determined plan of action to counter feeling lost.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Lakshmana instills resolve by declaring unwavering commitment to the search mission.
Outcome/Resolution: He shifts the focus from passive grieving to active strategy.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Sankalpa (Unwavering spiritual determination to uphold righteous action)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Firm spiritual resolve (Sankalpa) overcomes seemingly insurmountable worldly obstacles in pursuit of Truth.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Goal-directed motivation: replacing helpless wallowing with concrete, determined action plans.
